test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven boys B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6 and B7 are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B1 is third to the left of B7. B4 is to immediate left of B1. B2 is second to the left of B6. B6 is not an immediate neighbour of B5.

Who are the immediate neighbours of B3?
solution:
**Explanation:**

From the given information:

Step 1: B1 is third to the left of B7.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d41b93bcd1bb573366446411e0a171e9570f816d10890958328b5a57f9ead103.png] 

Step 2: B4 is to immediate left of B1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d852bf9cb12b5c5b023a2480e29e65ff84865cdbc6f75d0072d1b5cdd6e7242.png] 

Step 3: B2 is second to the left of B6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca5f88b7be1e342124d30c8b9dd650f8ce12bc00b54dae55b6a84d0cb1404a1f.png] 

We have to place B6 and B2 with one space in between and it can be only possible with B7 in between because in other cases we will not be able to fulfill the given conditions.

Step 4: B6 is not an immediate neighbour of B5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02d44dd759a5b71a4faf06983bf1c58727e2cdf047119581b327da2471cfed8c.png] 

We place B5 near B1 because we cannot place it with B6 ans then we place B3 at the only spot left.

So from the arrangement we can see that, **B4 and B6 are immediate neighbors of B3.**

**Hence the correct answer is option 4.**
